meta.name: Create Teable records from incoming webhook requests using a REST API

name: Teable - Webhook Record Creator

parameters.content:
## Teable - Webhook Record Creator

### How it works

This workflow receives record data through a webhook, validates and reshapes the incoming payload, then sends it to Teable’s create records API. After Teable returns the result, the workflow responds to the original webhook request with the creation outcome.

### Setup steps

- Configure the webhook URL and HTTP method expected by external callers.
- Set the Teable API authentication required by the HTTP Request node, such as an API token or Authorization header.
- Configure the Teable base URL, base ID, table ID, and any required request fields used by the validation/code step and API call.
- Test the webhook with a sample payload to confirm records are created and the response format is correct.

### Customization

Adjust the validation and preparation code to match the incoming payload shape, required Teable fields, and any default values or transformations needed before record creation.

## Receive and prepare request

Handles the incoming webhook call and validates or formats the submitted record data before it is sent onward.

## Create and return records

Calls the Teable create records API with the prepared payload, then sends the API result back as the webhook response.

description:
Power your workflows with Teable at https://teable.ai/. This workflow receives records through a Webhook and creates them in Teable using the REST API. API reference: https://help.teable.ai/en/api-doc/overview

Before activation, set TEABLE_TOKEN (Personal Access Token) in the n8n runtime. Optionally set TEABLE_BASE_URL for a self-hosted instance; it defaults to https://app.teable.ai.
